description.narrative:
Building a European Programme: youth mobilization for climate justice(including Just Energy Transition) A new alliance that will mobilize youth and strengthen their movements for climate justice across Europe
The assignment: During the Berlin meeting of EuropeanOxfam affiliates PDs in September 2023, the added value of Climate Justice was evident to all participants, including when linked to inequality.. A possible key policy hook for this work is the Fit for 55 implementation at the domestic level. Work that started toget traction in many European countries is the mobilization of youth for climate justice, which would also require a good partnership strategy. Enforcing climate justice through EU procurement rules was another opportunity that cameup in the discussion. Funding opportunities for this work might be through (a renewal of) EC DEAR in 2025.Criteria to decide the domestic program topics where identified: (1) link with the GSF, Horizon Roadmap, and global work; (2) resources (funding andHR), including existing capacity; (3)support by a critical number of affiliates; (4) pragmatism and action ability, with a clear ToC; (5)Oxfam’s added value and legitimacy in the context; (6) campaign ability. With regard to the critical number of affiliates, consensus was reached that at least a majority (e.g. five) of European affiliates need to engage, and preferably all would in one way or the other engage. Youth mobilization forclimate justice was classified as a level 2 priority (majority of affiliates contribute, existing work is built on and expanded with a clear(er) European angle. Might grow into level 1 work) and will be the focus of next steps. participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib was founded in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Oxfam Novib is member of the Oxfam International confederation. Working together in the confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education for all, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam Novib's main office is based in The Netherlands, it supports the work of a network of local offices, the implementation of global projects, fundraising, campaigning and advocacy. Oxfam Novib’s the Hague office contributes towards this project’s implementation.
